description: This file defines an Android activity named ActionBarNavigation which demonstrates the use of the ActionBar for navigation, including configuring the 'up' affordance and starting new activities in response to button clicks.

classes.name: ActionBarNavigation
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates navigation using the action bar, including handling button clicks to launch new activities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, configures the action bar, and updates the UI based on the intent category.

methods.name: onNewActivity
methods.description: Starts a new activity of type ActionBarNavigationTarget when a button is clicked.

methods.name: onNewDocument
methods.description: Starts a new activity of type ActionBarNavigationTarget with the FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_DOCUMENT when a button is clicked.
